description: Two Bun packages live here — the root API and the separate (non-workspace) web/ frontend — so most groups deliberately match on package name rather than on a manager or a directory, and pick up both packages at once when they share a dependency.

customManagers.description: Track the pinned bun-version in the CI workflows as the oven/bun Docker image, so it groups with the Dockerfile base image below

packageRules.description: The Dockerfile base image and the CI workflow's bun-version are the same runtime and must never drift apart — one PR bumps both
Pinned-to-SHA workflow actions; harmless to review in one PR
Effect and its platform packages release together and their types are tightly coupled
Drizzle ORM and its CLI generate/consume the same migration format
React runtime and its type packages must stay on the same major
Tailwind and its Vite plugin share a version line
Radix primitives underpinning the shadcn/ui components
cn() in src/lib/utils.ts is built out of these three, and the shadcn/ui primitives are generated against them together
The login/register forms wire react-hook-form to the Zod schemas through @hookform/resolvers, which peer-depends on both
openapi-typescript generates src/lib/api.gen.ts and openapi-fetch consumes it — bumping one without the other can break the generated client
Linting and formatting toolchain, shared by the root package and web/
Both packages typecheck against the same compiler; splitting the bump leaves one of them lint- or build-broken
TypeScript is held on 5.x deliberately: typescript-eslint hard-errors on TS 7 (see CLAUDE.md). Re-enable once typescript-eslint supports it.
Ambient type packages for the two runtimes, no runtime impact
